questions.stem: A 45-year-old man who works on a bird farm presents with recurrent episodes of cough, shortness of breath, and fever. His symptoms worsen during the workweek and improve over the weekend when he is away from work.CT scan of the chest shows ground-glass opacities All of the following statements are true regarding histological features of the diagnosis except?
questions.solutionHtml:
Eosinophilic abscess
  • The given clinical scenario is suggestive of Hypersensitivity pneumonitis (HP).
  • An eosinophilic abscess is not a typical feature of HP, and its presence should raise the possibility of other diagnoses, such as eosinophilic pneumonia or acute eosinophilic pneumonia.


Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 695
